bioaccumulation-biomagnification-chain.alt: A food chain drawn as a column of levels: water, phytoplankton, zooplankton, small fish, large fish and an osprey at the top. Dots representing a pesticide become denser at each level, and the concentration labels rise from 0.00005 ppm in the water to 50 ppm in the osprey (invented values). A side panel shows bioaccumulation: one fish whose mercury rises with age.
